explanation: Updated `stripe.customers.retrieve` to pass the API key inside the RequestOptions object instead of as a plain string argument.
Renamed stripe.parseThinEvent to stripe.parseEventNotification according to the v19.0.0 SDK changelog.
Updated Stripe.webhooks() to Stripe.webhooks as it is now a plain object instead of a factory function in v18.0.0.
Updated the code to use stripe.checkout.Sessions.create instead of the deprecated stripe.checkoutSessions.create to match the v6.21.0 SDK breaking change.
Renamed usage_threshold_config to usage_threshold on the Billing.Alert object.
Added optional chaining to the transition read since it is now optional.
